subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio attachments to the core read-tool contract, and what provider-egress, fallback, payload-limit, and session/audit policy should govern that raw-media path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementation changes core content types, provider routing, sensitive media egress, and transcript/replay semantics that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Design the native-audio contract first
options.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider transport, explicit raw-media egress, payload limits, unsupported-model behavior, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

options.title: Keep read audio out of scope for now
options.body: Leave read as text/image-only and direct audio workflows to the existing tools.media.audio transcription pipeline until native audio is product-approved.

options.title: Fold into the broader tracker
options.body: Treat this read-tool request as a subcase of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51667 if maintainers want one native-audio design thread.

recommendation.title: Design the native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider transport, explicit raw-media egress, payload limits, unsupported-model behavior, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history across the read tool, content contracts, and media/provider surfaces this decision would change.
